abstractive.text:
All tweets presented contain “Obama” regardless of time, context, or any other denoting remarks if not explicitly stated within the tweet.
Many people found President Obama a contentious president due to policies enacted during his tenure, covering subjects in Medical, Financial, and Gun control legislation.
Anytime there was a direct reference to a ‘female’ Obama, the comments were more about their appearance only.
A majority of the tweets were negative, often featuring racial slurs, or coded-language referencing racist derogatives like “monkey” or “Uncle”.
Most people concluded that President Obama “took” things away such as guns, Rights, or freedoms, if they were not explicitly stated, heavily implied.

Obama was just reelected to a second term as US President.
Obama has supported stricter gun control, higher taxes, expanding healthcare, and more government spending.
There are a lot of opposing opinions regarding Obama's political positions.
Conservatives tend to oppose Obama, whereas liberals tend to support him or criticize him for not changing things enough.
Obama’s wife is Michelle Obama and people often talk about her fashion choices.
